output.title: Add EUR 360 to your emergency reserve
output.description: Earmark EUR 360 from uncommitted available cash (EUR 2405.01 safe after upcoming bills) into your accessible emergency cushion.
output.rationale: Organizes existing liquid funds for an emergency goal; liquid coverage is 2.88 months. Earmarking equally liquid cash does not itself increase liquidity. Checker must verify obligations over the 90-day horizon.

output.title: Pay an extra EUR 850 toward Credit card
output.description: Apply EUR 850 above the required minimum toward Credit card (21.9% APR).
output.rationale: Targets Credit card principal reduction. Checker must confirm current debt terms and deterministic code must calculate interest effects; no interest-accrual assumption is made here (R006, F008).

output.title: Cancel unused Sound Library subscription (observed charge EUR 10.99)
output.description: Observed charge EUR 10.99 at Sound Library. Confirm usage, recurrence and cancellation terms before calculating any savings.
output.rationale: Recurring charge detected at Sound Library; requires user usage and cancellation-term confirmation per R010.
